title.zh: 将卡林加省 Pinukpuk 市镇 Cawagayan 中学（Tuga 国立中学附属校）从 Tabuk 市镇该校分离并改设为独立的 Cawagayan 国立中学并拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Cawagayan Barangay High School, also known as the Tuga National High School - Cawagayan Annex in the Municipality of Pinukpuk, Province of Kalinga from the Tuga National High School in the Municipality of Tabuk, and Converting it into an Independent National High School to be known as the Cawagayan National High School and appropriating funds therefor
title.orig: An Act Separating the Cawagayan Barangay High School, also known as the Tuga National High School - Cawagayan Annex in the Municipality of Pinukpuk, Province of Kalinga from the Tuga National High School in the Municipality of Tabuk, and Converting it into an Independent National High School to be known as the Cawagayan National High School and appropriating funds therefor

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 6 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2000/ra_8950_2000.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Cawagayan Barangay High School, also known as the Tuga National High School - Cawagayan Annex in the Municipality of Pinukpuk, Province of Kalinga is hereby separated from the Tuga National High School in the Municipality of Tabuk, and converted into a separate and independent national high school to be known as the Cawagayan National High School.

The school shall offer secondary education proper, as well as secondary science courses to carry out its objectives, as may be authorized by the Secretary of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports.
The Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act.
All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Cawagayan Barangay High School are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Cawagayan National High School.

The amount necessary for the implementation of this Act shall be charged against the current year's appropriations of the Tuga National High School - Cawagayan Annex. Thereafter, such sums as may be necessary for the operation and maintenance of the Cawagayan National High School shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
